description:
T10 Bluetooth calling smartwatch with a 2.09″ HD large display is made for people who want easy readability and quick wrist calling at a budget price. The big 2.09-inch screen keeps caller ID, messages, and app notifications clear—even when you’re moving, outdoors, or in a hurry. Pair it with your phone and take calls from your wrist using the built-in mic and speaker, so you can keep your phone in your pocket during commutes, workouts, or work.

An action button gives fast access to key functions, saving time when you need them most. Track daily activity and movement to stay consistent with your routine, and enjoy up to 5 days of typical battery life. Finished with a comfortable orange fabric-style strap and magnetic charging, the T10 is a practical everyday smartwatch for Android and iOS users who want a big screen and calling without the premium price tag.

features: 2.09-inch HD large display (320×385): Bigger, clearer viewing for calls, notifications, watch faces, and daily stats without squinting.
Bluetooth calling with mic + speaker: Answer and talk from your wrist when paired to your phone—useful for commuting, cooking, and workouts.
Action button for faster control: Quick access to key functions so you can do more with fewer taps.
Smooth touch navigation: Simple swipe-and-tap interface for everyday use and quick menu access.
Daily activity & movement tracking: Keeps you aware of steps and routine movement for basic fitness motivation.
Smart notifications: See call alerts, messages, and app updates on your wrist so you check your phone less.
Comfortable orange fabric-style strap: Breathable, casual look that feels good for long wear and gym sessions.
Up to 5 days typical battery + magnetic charging: Spend less time charging and more time wearing; snap-on magnetic charging is easy and secure.
